name: aio-rust
description: Panic-free Rust for AI agents: a strict clippy profile (unwrap, expect, panic, indexing, overflowing arithmetic, truncating casts; unsafe forbidden) applied by script, a replacement table for every rejected panic site, and a check gate (profile-enforced clippy, no lint escapes, tests) before done. 2 skills: aio-rust (panic-free code) and aio-rust-build (fast builds with bounded disk: debuginfo, per-workspace build-dir, sccache, incremental kept on, cleanup, safe for parallel agents).
